notes: Native excerpts from the unchanged vendor run in an instrumented fixture, not the full Roblox renderer.
The fixture callback failure warning is injected intentionally and asserted.
Integrated evidence and current bundle hashes are in tests/release-test-results.json.
Suspended-window cases execute the real bridge factory against an instrumented native constructor, including a healthy complete-window control.
Post-window initialization runs the real bridge factory with suspended server-page and config-listing fixtures, including healthy controls and exact-once cleanup checks.
Config callbacks execute the real bridge against suspended config-manager fixtures. Calls already inside external storage can finish; follow-on calls and closed UI updates are fenced.

Native CurrentConfig and Configs are published inside vendor creation before registration. Only bridge.Config publication is fenced; no native-manager transaction is claimed. Closed late candidates have legacy Load disabled. Cancelled manual-load false/throw outcomes do not mutate closed LastError.

Callback lifecycle contracts execute the real bridge and vendor slider excerpts. Setter/notification suspensions are instrumented. Listener and Pending retention assertions are not real-device heap/FPS measurements; already entered native calls are not rolled back.

Layout contracts execute the real bridge with instrumented UIScale/center suspension, camera state, and deferred queues. Each layout fixture asserts no deferred errors. Cache completion means native-method return, not completion of vendor 0.2s scale / 0.45s center tweens. Already entered native calls can finish after cancellation; no real Android renderer/FPS result is claimed.

Dropdown cases execute unchanged vendor Callback, Refresh commit tail, and Select with instrumented item-building and task scheduling. SetValues requests are serialized in batches of up to eight; failures stop the batch and clear pending intent for explicit retry. This does not establish full native GUI behavior for concurrent Select/SetValues, restore a partially built native menu, undo entered native calls, or measure Android FPS.
